name: Cöch
summary: Italian partnership point-trick game with a 40-card doubled deck, partners opposite, highest card of led suit wins.
rules_text: Four players in fixed partnerships opposite, play anticlockwise with 40 cards (20 pairs: Figures I-X and Matte 10 ranks). Deal 10 cards each in two fives. No trumps. Player to dealer's right leads any card. Others must follow suit of the led suit (Figure or Matte) if able, otherwise play the other suit. Highest rank of led suit wins the trick; if two identical copies meet, the first played wins. Winner leads next. Play 10 tricks. Cards have values: V-VIIII 0.5 each, X 1, XI-Brescia 1, total 19. Team winning 10+ points wins the hand. If 9.5 each, recount with alternate values I,VI,XI=1 up to Brescia=6, total 82, need 42 to win; 41-41 is a draw.
rating_reason: Italian partnership point-trick game, turn-based strategic trick taking
